metadata.name: Ecodesign for Java
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for Java code: sober JPA/Hibernate, memory, batching, serialisation, logging.

donnees.name: Java — data access (JPA / Hibernate / JDBC)
donnees.description: Load only what is needed, in as few round trips as possible (RGESN Backend, GR491_Backend_2/3).

rules.title: findAll() on an unbounded table
rules.description: Loads every row and manages them as managed entities: memory, CPU and network proportional to the table size.
rules.recommendation: Paginate as a matter of course (Pageable, setMaxResults); process large volumes in chunks.

rules.title: Lazy association walked in a loop (N+1)
rules.description: A @OneToMany or @ManyToMany collection walked lazily fires one query per parent element.
rules.recommendation: Load the associations you walk explicitly with JOIN FETCH or @EntityGraph; project into a DTO for read-only access.

example.good: @Query("select o from Order o join fetch o.customer")

rules.title: Writes one entity at a time
rules.description: One save() per entity produces one database round trip per row, with no JDBC batching.
rules.recommendation: JDBC batching (hibernate.jdbc.batch_size, saveAll in slices), Spring Batch for long jobs; size the HikariCP pool to the real need.

memoire.name: Java — memory and CPU
memoire.description: Limit allocations, unmeasured parallelism and unbounded caches (RGESN Algorithms, GR491_Backend_4).

rules.title: parallelStream() by default
rules.description: parallelStream takes over every core of the common ForkJoinPool for a gain that is rarely measured, and degrades concurrent processing.
rules.recommendation: Stay on a sequential stream by default; parallelise only after measurement, on a dedicated pool.

rules.title: String concatenation in a loop
rules.description: `s += ...` allocates a new String on every iteration: needless memory and GC pressure in hot loops.
rules.recommendation: StringBuilder for repeated concatenation; avoid boxing in pipelines (IntStream rather than Stream<Integer>).

rules.title: Unbounded static cache
rules.description: A static Map used as a cache grows without limit: memory held until restart, and possibly an OOM.
rules.recommendation: Caffeine with maximumSize plus expireAfterWrite, or an external cache with a TTL.

logs_taches.name: Java — APIs, logging and scheduled tasks
logs_taches.description: Serialise little, log soberly, do not poll (RGESN Backend/Hosting).

rules.title: Concatenated log instead of a parameterised one
rules.description: A concatenation inside a log call is evaluated even when the level is disabled: CPU and allocations for a line never written.
rules.recommendation: Parameterised logging (log.debug("x={}", x)); no logging inside tight loops; sober production levels.

rules.title: High-frequency scheduled task
rules.description: A @Scheduled job polling a state in a loop consumes CPU and database capacity continuously to catch a rare change.
rules.recommendation: Event-driven triggering (listener, message) where possible; failing that, widen the interval and serialise the runs.
